status: protocol frozen before execution; QA candidate only

sourceScope.candidatePinPolicy: Root must pin the completed candidate before any run. Reversing its one approved direction-literal replacement must reproduce the complete frozen original bytes.
sourceScope.allowedChange: Only updateEnemies line423: replace the non-escaping {x:e.navX||0,y:e.navY||0} direction literal and its local property uses with directionX/directionY scalar locals.
preserve: Read e.navX then e.navY once each; preserve truthiness and original ToPrimitive/coercion order, angle setter, speed reads twice, move receiver/arguments/return/throw behavior.
No damping, navigation, separation, collision, fields/LRU, spawning, entity count, AI cadence, asset, quality, RNG, IDs, events or save change.
Production engine.js remains the frozen original unless all later adoption gates are independently met. This protocol does not authorize product installation.

originalFixture.title: twenty minutes of seeded autopilot keeps entity pools finite and bounded
originalFixture.stressOnlyInvulnerability: Keep the existing game.player.invul=1 assignment exactly; it is explicitly a stress fixture, not normal combat evidence.
commandsAndAssertions: Keep first upgrade choice selection, first living enemy aim, tick/300 movement, dash tick%80, lure tick%250, molotov tick%350 and shoot:true exactly.
Drain original events exactly once after every original tick; do not add a drain, tick, pose update or method observer.
Preserve all original every100tick pool, position, hp/parts and blocked-player assertions, plus final simulated/time/kills assertions.
Preserve the original strict CPU assertion cpuMs<15000 and the original20000ms test timeout; do not turn a failed budget into a pass by changing either threshold.

diagnosticProfile.reason: The CPU profile adds instrumentation and is only hotspot evidence. It is not the unprofiled A/B/A baseline or a measurement of eliminated allocations.

executionPlan.processes: Three sequential fresh independent Node.js22 processes with identical flags, environment, source dependency URLs and fixture input. No concurrent Node/test/profile/browser/GPU job.
prohibited: No --cpu-prof or debugger/profiler in the acceptance runs, no forced GC, no warmup, no process reuse, no retry to seek a passing bracket.
No per-tick checkpoint/hash/event instrumentation, method observer, allocation counter or static Game setting alteration in the measured loop.
No imports, source hashing, JSON serialization, report comparison, final checkpoint hashing or cleanup inside the simulation timers.
executionPlan.wholeRun: Measure original-loop CPU and call wall at full precision, including the identical bounded window clock overhead in all arms. Preserve original rounded diagnostics only as display, not as the gate calculation.

windows.timingPolicy: Only twelve fixed boundary measurements; do not change commands, event drains or original assertions. All boundary clock/CPU costs remain included in the outer run. Window sums are not assumed to equal outer time exactly.
windows.p95Definition: Nearest rank: sorted[ceil(0.95*n)-1]. With n=12, p95 is the12th value and therefore equals max; these are not independent tail confirmations.
windows.baselineLimitation: Windowed runs add bounded measurement work. They compare identical A/B/A protocols and must not be described as byte-identical timing of the original uninstrumented callback. The unchanged whole test remains separate validation.

executionPlan.finalState: Capture and hash final checkpoint, relevant runtime effects/pools and both RNG states only after every timer stops. A final hash alone cannot establish discarded per-tick event order.
executionPlan.failureRetention: Use new exclusive output paths. Retain every original result, failure, exit status, timing, source pin and comparison; never overwrite bad evidence with a later run.

allRequired: All three arms finish the full24000 original ticks and satisfy all original functional/pool assertions; the candidate must also pass the unchanged15000ms CPU budget and20000ms test-timeout contract.
Independent frozen-original whole-engine source/provenance oracle passes; direction getters/coercions/setters/speed reads/move exceptions preserve the original observable order.
Root's independent2166 comparisons over two seeds and60/180/210 actors show exact full state, actions/events and both RNG streams each tick, with no relaxed tolerance or filtered mismatches.
Final benchmark state/runtime/RNG hashes are equal across A1/B/A2.
Candidate CPU gain >=3% against min(A1 CPU,A2 CPU), and candidate wall gain >=3% against min(A1 wall,A2 wall), using full precision and checking the two metrics independently.
Candidate2000tick-window CPU p95/max and wall p95/max do not exceed the corresponding value of either original arm; no tail tolerance is introduced.
nodeGate.onAnyFailure: Park the candidate OFF. Do not tune, retry, weaken assertions, combine another optimization or install product code within this atomic task.
nodeGate.claimLimit: Even a passing single bracket is one controlled-host result, not guaranteed cross-device benefit, measured heap elimination, GPU improvement or presented FPS. V8 may already scalarize the original literal.

browserGate.ifNodeFails: Candidate remains OFF; any original-only browser quality check is evidence for the unchanged current renderer, not candidate validation or a replacement cost bracket.
browserGate.limitations: Actual rAF scheduling and fixed-work callback timing are distinct. Do not claim presented FPS or compare prior browser callback costs as direct A/B when schedule/profile scopes differ.

finalValidation.wholeSuite: Root runs the existing whole test suite once after final source freeze, with the original concurrency/budgets and all failures preserved.
finalValidation.adoption: This review authorizes no adoption. Passing Node is only permission to attempt the separate browser quality gate; any unresolved state, pixels, resources or original-suite failure remains explicit.
